name: DominoForm – Form Builder (unreleased)
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoForm is a minimalistic and lightweight form builder plugin. It allows you to quickly add a basic contact form to your WordPress website using a simple shortcode.

With DominoForm, you don’t need to configure complex settings. Just use the shortcode [dominoform_contact] on any page or post, and your users will be able to send you messages directly from your website.

Features:
* Easy to use.
* Lightweight and fast.
* Simple shortcode implementation.
* Secure and sanitized inputs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [dominoform_contact] on any post, page, or text widget to display the form.
sections.faq:
How do I use the contact form?

Simply place the shortcode [dominoform_contact] into the content area of any post or page where you want the form to appear.

short_description: A simple, lightweight, and easy-to-use form builder for WordPress. Create beautiful contact forms using a simple shortcode.
